description: This file contains utility functions for reading file contents into memory and printing input/output data, particularly for unit testing purposes. It includes functions to read a file into a memory buffer and to print the contents of that buffer along with other data.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file into a provided memory buffer within a test_ut_memory_t structure, handling file opening, size determination, allocation, and reading.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file loaded into memory and a given key-value pair data string to standard output, managing memory cleanup after reading.
